notes: OFFICIAL NAME CONFIRMED on ayaneo.com: the product page <title> and heading read 'AYANEO Flip 1S DS' (URL /product/AYANEO-Flip-1S-DS) while AYANEO's own launch articles style it 'AYANEO FLIP 1S DS' and the spec sheet renders it as 'AYANEO FL_IP 1S (DS)'. Both casings are AYANEO's; 'FLIP 1S DS' is used as the model string and the variants are in aliases. As with the Flip DS, dimensions/mass/display parameters are published by AYANEO ONLY inside a spec-sheet IMAGE on the product page (.../product/2025/AYANEO_FLIP_1S_DS_EN_20250710/07.webp), read visually; the page HTML carries no text specs and AYANEO's own store (shop.ayaneo.com) product body contains only a customs notice. AYANEO prints one size, '180*102*29.3mm (35.7mm at the grip)' = folded/closed state → dimensions_mm.closed; open state is not published (null). 35.7mm 'at the grip' is a grip bulge, not a hinge thickness → depth_at_hinge null. AXIS ORDERING: 180mm is the long edge (landscape width in use), recorded as `height` per the OEM-ordering rule. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + sourced resolution: 25.4*D*w/hypot(w,h) x 25.4*D*h/hypot(w,h). The derivation is corroborated by AYANEO's own printed PPI: 7in/1920x1080 → 314.7 PPI vs AYANEO's '315 PPI', and 4.5in/1620x1080 → 432.7 PPI vs AYANEO's '433PPI' — both match, so the diagonals are close to exact. Secondary panel is IPS → recorded as LCD per the schema enum. Main-screen refresh: AYANEO lists 144/120/90/60Hz; 144 recorded as the maximum. Secondary-screen refresh is not published (null). stick/trigger/bumper counts are not stated by AYANEO → null rather than guessed; abxy=4 / dpad=1 follow from AYANEO's own 'cross key and ABXY buttons'. Ports: both USB-C ports are full-function USB4 40Gbps with DP 1.4 and PD. ANNOUNCED 2025-06-10 = AYANEO's unveiling article; RELEASED 2025-07-10 = AYANEO's own 'officially launched' date, which is simultaneously the pre-order/IGG opening — AYANEO states 'Pre-orders Now Open, First Batch Ready for Immediate Shipment', so on this model the launch and first shipment are not separated by AYANEO. CPU options: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 or Ryzen 7 8840U (AYANEO's article 884 mentioned an 'AMD Ryzen 7 7840U' variant for the earlier Flip DS, not this one). external_ids.igdb_platform null: Windows PC, not an IGDB platform.
